card.title: Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2

claims.statement: Elite Series 2 is Model 1797 with USB-C, internal battery, Bluetooth; USB ID 045E:0B00 (USB), 045E:0B05 (Bluetooth), 045E:0B22 (BLE); its charging dock is Model 1924.
Most accessories (sticks, paddles) are not interchangeable with the Series 1 Elite.

card.caveats: USB-C diode values are only in an image. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
